task: Deepen (flagship 3) sales-agent: (3b) Qwen2.5 14B local model on the reply sets, and (1) the Enron third reader with the same 14B

errors.what: llama-cpp-python server killed by the kernel (OOM) loading the 14B with mmap on: AMX repack keeps a second copy beside the mapped file

doc_friction.issue: sales-agent buildable said huggingface.co answered 403 on 2026-11-12; it answered 200 this run, downloads included. Probe-first advice was right; the stale 403 note would have sent a less careful run elsewhere.
7B setup did not mention --use_mmap; at 14B on this CPU the default load OOMs. Now documented.
pgrep hook blocks a bracketed pattern if the same word appears elsewhere in the command (e.g. in the nohup line); had to split commands and use a pid file.

deviations.why: The 611-reply 14B run takes about 3.5 h; rather than hold the PR, landed the 181-reply result, the Enron reader result and a pre-registered test first, and left the 611 test as the next buildable item (it continues in a follow-up PR if this session lasts).
deviations.did: merged interim results with the test pre-registered on main before the held-out answers exist
deviations.result: pre-registration is on main before the data, which a single end-of-run PR could not show

writeups: ventures/sales-agent/eval/README.md (A 14B local model on the same replies)
notes: Local checks: node --test in ventures/sales-agent (see PR). Measurements: 181 replies (honest pair + five trap probes): 14B alone 144 vs 7B 136, merged 146 vs 147, false opt-outs alone 9 vs 6, close flags 8/1 vs 8/4; closes on rules-unclear 7/7 vs 7/11. Enron 5* 107 stops: 14B vs agent readers 70%/75% (kappa 0.56/0.64) vs 81%/0.71 between agents; 15 of 53 agreed-none stops called a stop (7B 13).

pricing.source: Anthropic pricing as cached in the Claude API skill (models table and per-model migration notes), 2026-10-06. Cache writes are 1.25x input (5-minute) and 2x input (1-hour); cache reads differ by model.

human_equivalent.basis: an ML engineer setting up a 14B CPU server, running and scoring 181 replies and 107 Enron stops, writing up and pre-registering a test

certainty.tokens: high: summed from the per-request `usage` the API returned, as the transcript recorded it, deduplicated by message id
certainty.model: high: the `model` field on each API response, not the configured model
certainty.api_equivalent_usd: medium: measured tokens x list prices in prompts/pricing.json (as_of stated); an equivalent, not a charge: these runs are billed under a subscription
certainty.time: medium: from transcript timestamps; model time is request-to-response, tool time is call-to-result, time waiting on a person is excluded from active time
certainty.human_equivalent: low: the agent's own estimate of how long a competent person would take, with its basis written down; never measured

not_counted: requests the harness makes outside the transcript (context compaction summaries, title generation, safety classifiers), if any
transcripts lost when a cloud session moved to a new container: only files present in this container are read, so a resumed session can undercount
server-tool fees (web search is billed per search, not per token); the count is recorded, not priced
